source_statement: Let ABC be a triangle such that AB = 6, BC = 5, AC = 7. Let the tangents to the circumcircle of ABC at B and C meet at X. Let Z be a point on the circumcircle of ABC. Let Y be the foot of the perpendicular from X to CZ. Let K be the intersection of the circumcircle of BCY with line AB. Given that Y is on the interior of segment CZ and Y Z = 3CY , compute AK.

clause_ledger.dsl: A,B,C with exact triangle side constraints

clause_ledger.source: X is intersection of tangents at B,C
Z on circumcircle; Y is foot from X to CZ; YZ=3CY
clause_ledger.dsl: Z variable on Gamma, Y=FootOfPerpendicular(X,Line(C,Z)), direct distance ratio

clause_ledger.source: K is intersection of circumcircle BCY with AB
